name: Compute Cluster S29: Win Rate Calculation
description: Tests: win_flag as dense 0/1 series using conditional_select (NOT sparse where). Mean of 0s and 1s = win rate. Trap: where(condition, 1.0) makes losses NaN → Mean = 100%.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S29: Win Rate Calculation
# =============================================================================
# S29 rules:
#   CORRECT: win_flag = conditional_select(ret > 0, 1.0, 0.0) → dense 0/1 series
#            Mean of 0s and 1s = true win rate
#   WRONG:   win_flag = where(condition, 1.0) → losses become NaN → Mean = 100% always

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === CORRECT: Dense 0/1 win flag ===
win_flag_correct = conditional_select(rets > 0, 1.0, 0.0)

# === WRONG (for demonstration): Sparse where — losses are NaN ===
win_flag_wrong = where(rets > 0, 1.0)

# === Rolling win rate (correct method) ===
rolling_wr = sma(win_flag_correct, 60)

# === Magnitude-aware: big wins vs small wins ===
big_win = conditional_select(rets > 0.01, 1.0, 0.0)
small_win = conditional_select(rets > 0, conditional_select(rets <= 0.01, 1.0, 0.0), 0.0)
loss_flag = conditional_select(rets <= 0, 1.0, 0.0)

# === Cumulative win count ===
cum_wins = agg(win_flag_correct, AggregationType.Sum)
cum_total = agg(conditional_select(is_valid(rets), 1.0, 0.0), AggregationType.Sum)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Win Rate (60d) — Correct Dense Method',
    category='Win Rate',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Win Rate', color=Color.Green)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='50%', color=Color.White, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rolling_wr)

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Wins vs Total Observations',
    category='Win Rate',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Wins', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum Total', color=Color.White)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cum_wins, cum_total))

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Win Rate Stats',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Win Rate Comparison: Correct vs Wrong',
      row_size=2, col_size=2,
      row_headers=['Correct (dense)', 'Wrong (sparse)'],
      col_headers=['Mean', 'Count'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(win_flag_correct, win_flag_correct, win_flag_wrong, win_flag_wrong)
